children.value: > Fact From Story OpenAI said Friday it has pushed out its co-founder and CEO Sam Altman after a review found he was “not consistently candid in his communications” with the board of directors.

> > Fact From Story Altman posted Friday on X: “i loved my time at openai. it was transformative for me personally, and hopefully the world a little bit. most of all i loved working with such talented people. will have more to say about what’s next later.”
> > > Fact From Story The board no longer has confidence in his ability to continue leading OpenAI.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge A CEO being pushed out of a company and the board losing confidence in him are signs that he was fired.
> > Fact From Story The board no longer has confidence in his ability to continue leading OpenAI.
> > > Fact From Story The statement said his behavior was hindering the board’s ability to exercise its responsibilities.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge If a CEO's behavior hinders the board's ability to exercise its responsibilities, the board might lose confidence in the CEO.
> > Commonsense Knowledge A CEO being pushed out of a company and the board losing confidence in him are signs that he was fired.
> Commonsense Knowledge When a company says it has pushed out its CEO, that means the CEO has been fired.
